title: Punjab Deploys Facial Recognition for Board Exams
excerpt: Punjab introduces a digital On-Screen Marking system using facial recognition to scan and check board exam answer sheets online.
body_html:
The province of Punjab is rolling out a new digital On-Screen Marking system designed for board examinations. Under this approach, students' answer sheets will be scanned and evaluated online.

Additionally, the system incorporates facial recognition technology as part of its deployment. The initiative aims to modernize the traditional examination checking process across the region.
